command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Write-Host "===== BOOKMARK IMPORT DIAGNOSTIC ====="
git fetch origin main work/bookmarks-winui --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "5228cbbfc24f56d61a84975545f1d8572e7deece") { throw "main moved" }
$status=@(git status --short)
if($status.Count -ne 0){$status|%{Write-Host $_};throw "unexpected local changes"}
git checkout work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "branch ff failed" }
$diag=@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from pywinauto import Desktop
ROOT=Path.cwd(); EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
base=ROOT/"logs"/"bookmark-import-diag";shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
source=base/"시작"; imported=base/"가져온폴더";appdata=base/"appdata";localdata=base/"localdata";temp=base/"tmp"
for q in (source,imported,appdata,localdata,temp):q.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer";profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
legacy=base/"legacy-bookmark.conf"
legacy.write_text("[bookmark]\r\nbookmark.item1.name=가져온 북마크\r\nbookmark.item1.path="+str(imported)+"\r\n",encoding="utf-16")
print("LEGACY_PATH",str(legacy),flush=True)
print("LEGACY_BYTES",legacy.read_bytes()[:12],len(legacy.read_bytes()),flush=True)
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),"TEMP":str(temp),"TMP":str(temp)}
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM];u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)];u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
def ev(fn,label,t=15):
 end=time.monotonic()+t
 while time.monotonic()<end:
  try:
   if fn():return
  except:pass
  time.sleep(.12)
 raise AssertionError(label)
def wins(pid):
 out=[]
 @CALL
 def cb(h,_):
  owner=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(owner))
  if owner.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):out.append(int(h))
  return 1
 u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return out
p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(source)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
ev(lambda:wins(p.pid) or p.poll() is not None,"window");assert p.poll() is None
hwnd=wins(p.pid)[0];win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd);el=lambda n:win.child_window(auto_id=n)
ev(lambda:str(source).lower() in el("AddressBox").get_value().lower(),"nav",18)
el("AddBookmarkButton").invoke()
ev(lambda:(profile/"bookmarks-v1.txt").exists(),"initial add")
el("BookmarkManagerButton").invoke()
ev(lambda:el("BookmarkImportPathBox").exists(),"manager children")
box=el("BookmarkImportPathBox");box.set_edit_text(str(legacy))
print("BOX_VALUE",repr(box.get_value()),flush=True)
print("STATUS_BEFORE_IMPORT",repr(el("StatusText").window_text()),flush=True)
el("BookmarkImportButton").invoke()
time.sleep(1.0)
print("STATUS_AFTER_IMPORT",repr(el("StatusText").window_text()),flush=True)
store=profile/"bookmarks-v1.txt"
print("STORE_TEXT_AFTER",repr(store.read_text(encoding="utf-8")),flush=True)
print("BUTTONS_AFTER",[b.window_text() for b in win.descendants(control_type="Button") if "북마크" in b.window_text()],flush=True)
u.PostMessageW(hwnd,0x0010,0,0);p.wait(timeout=12);print("EXIT",p.returncode,flush=True)
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath logs\bookmark-import-diagnostic.py -Value $diag -Encoding utf8
python -X utf8 logs\bookmark-import-diagnostic.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "import diagnostic failed" }
